quote: Hercules (Herakles) was a hero of Greek mythology famous for his great strength and endurance.

statement.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang terkenal karena kekuatan dan daya tahannya.
statement.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero renowned for strength and endurance.

quote: In mythology, though, it was Zeus who lay with Alkmene and so fathered Hercules, explaining the origin of Hercules' great strength.

statement.id: Zeus disebut sebagai ayah Herakles dan Alkmene sebagai ibunya.
statement.en: Zeus is named as Heracles's father and Alkmene as his mother.

quote: Hera also sent two snakes to kill the new-born Hercules, but the baby easily strangled them.

statement.id: Hera mengirim dua ular kepada Herakles bayi, tetapi ia mencekiknya.
statement.en: Hera sent two snakes to the infant Heracles, who strangled them.

quote: Heracles was commanded by the Delphic Oracle to perform twelve labors for King Eurystheus of Mycenae.

statement.id: Peramal Delphi memerintahkannya menjalani dua belas tugas untuk Raja Eurystheus.
statement.en: The Delphic Oracle ordered Heracles to perform twelve labors for Eurystheus.

quote: Heracles journeyed to Delphi, and on inquiring of the god regarding the matter he received a reply which stated that the gods had decided that he should perform twelve Labours at the command of Eurystheus and that upon their conclusion he should receive the gift of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut Diodorus, Herakles menjalani dua belas tugas atas perintah Eurystheus dan dijanjikan keabadian setelah selesai.
statement.en: Diodorus says Heracles was commanded to complete twelve labors and promised immortality afterward.

quote: Hercules strangled the lion with his bare hands and forever after wore its pelt as a protective cloak.

statement.id: Herakles mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya.
statement.en: Heracles strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt.

quote: Heracles was worshipped throughout Greece in the classical age as a god.

statement.id: Herakles juga dipuja sebagai dewa di Yunani pada zaman klasik.
statement.en: Heracles was worshipped as a god throughout classical Greece.

quote: Hera once more interfered and drove Hercules insane so that he killed his wife and children.

statement.id: Hera membuat Herakles gila sehingga ia membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya.
statement.en: Hera drove Heracles insane so that he killed his wife and children.

quote: Helped by his faithful companion and nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads re-growing, Hercules eventually killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

statement.id: Dibantu keponakannya Iolaos yang memakai api agar kepala Hydra tidak tumbuh lagi, Herakles membunuh Hydra dan mencelupkan anak panahnya ke darah beracunnya.
statement.en: With the help of his nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads regrowing, Heracles killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

quote: On his journey in Hades, the hero encounters many souls and persuades the god Hades to allow him to take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke Hades, Herakles membujuk dewa Hades agar mengizinkannya membawa Kerberos asalkan tanpa senjata.
statement.en: On his journey in Hades, Heracles persuades the god Hades to let him take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

quote: Hercules shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus

statement.id: Herakles menembak jatuh elang itu dengan anak panah dan membebaskan Prometheus.
statement.en: Heracles shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus.

quote: Immortality was assured, though, when Athena descended in her chariot and took Hercules from the flames to Mount Olympus where he married the goddess Hebe, was given the gift of eternal youth, and permitted to reside with the gods for all time.

statement.id: Athena membawa Herakles dari api ke Gunung Olympus, tempat ia menikahi dewi Hebe, diberi masa muda abadi, dan diizinkan tinggal bersama para dewa selamanya.
statement.en: Athena took Heracles from the flames to Mount Olympus, where he married the goddess Hebe, received eternal youth, and was allowed to live with the gods forever.

quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical pottery art Hercules is often depicted carrying a knotted club, a quiver full of arrows, and wearing a lion's pelt with sometimes also a lion's head helmet.

statement.id: Dalam seni tembikar Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Herakles sering digambarkan membawa gada berbuku, wadah anak panah, dan mengenakan kulit singa, kadang dengan helm berkepala singa.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek pottery, Heracles is often shown carrying a knotted club and a quiver of arrows and wearing a lion pelt, sometimes with a lion-head helmet.

quote: It was on his journey to this island in the western ocean that he set markers in the Strait of Gades which thereafter became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke pulau di samudra barat itu, ia memasang penanda di Selat Gades yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Tiang-tiang Herkules.
statement.en: On his journey to that island in the western ocean, he set markers in the Strait of Gades that became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

quote: Hercules received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo ... a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; for he had himself cut a club at Nemea.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Herakles menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena; gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Heracles received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; he had cut his club himself at Nemea.

quote: A Libyan giant who drew his strength directly from the earth. He challenged Heracles to a wrestling death match but was defeated when the hero lifted him from the earth and crushed him.
locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Antaeus

statement.id: Antaeus, raksasa Libya yang menarik kekuatan dari bumi, mengajak Herakles bergulat sampai mati, tetapi kalah ketika Herakles mengangkatnya dari tanah dan meremukkannya.
statement.en: Antaeus, a Libyan giant who drew strength from the earth, challenged Heracles to a deadly wrestling match but was defeated when Heracles lifted him from the earth and crushed him.

quote: The god of death. Heracles defeated him in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.
locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Thanatus

statement.id: Herakles mengalahkan Thanatos, dewa kematian, dalam adu gulat ketika Thanatos datang menjemput Alcestis ke dunia bawah.
statement.en: Heracles defeated Thanatos, the god of death, in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.

quote: Ancient Greek: Ἡρακλῆς, lit. 'glory/fame of Hera'

statement.id: Nama Yunani Ἡρακλῆς secara harfiah berarti "kemuliaan/ketenaran Hera".
statement.en: The Greek name Ἡρακλῆς literally means "glory/fame of Hera".

quote: He was thought to be both a hero and a god, possessing superhuman strength. No tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

statement.id: Herakles dianggap sekaligus pahlawan dan dewa, memiliki kekuatan manusia super; tidak ada makam yang pernah dipastikan sebagai miliknya, dan pada sebagian festival kurban dipersembahkan kepadanya lebih dulu sebagai pahlawan lalu sebagai dewa.
statement.en: Heracles was thought to be both hero and god, possessing superhuman strength; no tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

quote: Deianeira decided to use the blood of Nessos, covered a cloak in it and gave it to a messenger to take to Hercules. The hero wore it but the impregnated cloak caused his skin to burn terribly.

statement.id: Deianeira melumuri jubah dengan darah Nessos dan mengirimkannya kepada Herakles; ketika dipakai, jubah itu membuat kulitnya terbakar hebat.
statement.en: Deianeira smeared a cloak with the blood of Nessos and sent it to Heracles; when he wore it, the cloak burned his skin terribly.

quote: The earliest complete depiction of Hercules' twelve labours in ancient sculpture is from the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed in 457 BCE).

statement.id: Penggambaran lengkap tertua kedua belas tugas Herakles dalam seni pahat kuno ada pada metope Kuil Zeus di Olimpia (selesai 457 SM).
statement.en: The earliest complete depiction of Heracles's twelve labours in ancient sculpture is on the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed 457 BCE).

quote: He was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

statement.id: Herakles dipuja luas sebagai pelindung kaum muda dan gimnasium.
statement.en: Heracles was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

quote: CERBERUS (Kerberos) The hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld. Heracles was sent to fetch the beast as one of his twelve labours, and captured it with the approval of the goddess Persephone.
locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Cerberus

statement.id: Kerberos, anjing Hades penjaga pintu masuk dunia bawah; Herakles diutus membawanya sebagai salah satu dari dua belas tugasnya dan menangkapnya dengan persetujuan dewi Persephone.
statement.en: Cerberus, the hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld; Heracles was sent to fetch him as one of his twelve labours and captured him with the approval of the goddess Persephone.
